name: 30117 · Carrollton, GA
findings: ZIP 30117 (Carrollton) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30117 (Carrollton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30117 (Carrollton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
